claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows one lens attached and a separate lens cap; no second lens or focal lengths are visible.

claims.claim: Clean and good to shoot videos and snapshots.
claims.evidence: The report does not show operation, sensor condition, cleanliness, or video/still performance.

risks.risk: Camera does not turn on or function.
risks.proof: Video clip of the camera powering on, navigating menus, taking a photo, and reviewing the image.

risks.risk: High shutter count or heavy usage history.
risks.proof: Screenshot or photo of the shutter count / camera info screen.

risks.risk: Scratches, fungus, or haze on sensor, mirror, or lens glass.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the sensor, mirror, and lens elements under bright light.

risks.risk: Missing battery, charger, box, manuals, or memory card.
risks.proof: Photo of all included accessories together.

risks.risk: Autofocus or metering does not perform correctly.
risks.proof: Video clip demonstrating autofocus lock and metering in different lighting.
risks.if_unproven: as manual focus only / metering unreliable

risks.risk: Unknown age, purchase date, or warranty status.
risks.proof: Photo of receipt, warranty card, or serial number for lookup.
risks.if_unproven: as out of warranty / unknown age

proof_requests: Video of the camera turning on and taking a photo.
Close-up photos of the sensor, mirror, and lens glass.
Photo of all accessories (battery, charger, box, manuals, card).
Screenshot of shutter count or camera info screen.
response.reason: The witness identifies a Nikon DSLR camera, so it can be priced at its worst case. Seller claims about a second lens, cleanliness, and video capability are not shown in the report.
